data.description: Implements ADR-0019 (accepted 2026-06-02). Replace the bespoke staged-*/PR1/PR2 two-tier promotion with GitHub Merge Queue: keep per-story sub-PR LLM review (cost win + primary goal), make deterministic Goal-1 backstops required on merge_group, identity containment unchanged, retire staged-*/check-staged-head/most resume logic. Sequenced per ADR migration outline. Prerequisite (independent): proposal P0 hardening, esp. S-11 admin-exemption ledger, before any enforce flip. Design+validation: docs/adr/0019-*, docs/designs/ci-pr-process-remediation-proposal.md; merge_group semantics empirically verified (PRs #544/#545, torn down).
data.title: Adopt GitHub Merge Queue for staged->main promotion (ADR-0019)
